intro: The Letter to Jorgen is a confidential missive drafted to enlist an old contact in Stormwind City. It serves as an operative's introduction during the early stages of an inquiry into a high-level diplomatic disappearance.

p: When a high-ranking diplomat bound for Theramore failed to arrive for scheduled talks with Lady Jaina Proudmoore, royal investigators scrambled to keep the incident quiet. While official agents began scouring the capital, alternative channels were quietly mobilized. This sealed letter was drafted to circumvent standard military bureaucracy, aimed specifically at Jorgen—a gruff veteran passing his days fishing beneath the colossal statues in the Valley of Heroes. The note calls upon old obligations, pulling an unwilling contact into a covert investigation touched by rumors of Defias conspiracy.
